def.label: 30 mm autocannon
def.note: 16b cut AE.2's numbers. Three rounds every 3,000 ms is 60 landed a pull, the cannon's 20 a second in bites of 20, and every round is its own draw under burst:<seq>, so what lands is a count and not all or nothing. A scout car's 200 front hull is ten landed rounds, four pulls; a heavy's 700 front is thirty-five, twelve pulls and thirty-six seconds. 1 km at 4 mrad and 2 km at 8 are both past any sight on this map. 105,000 cm/s is 1,050 m/s, so a shot at 600 m is about 0.57 s in the air. 240 rounds are 80 pulls.
